CLEAN_over_high_on_medium_low_awarded.note: the un-confounded signal: surfaces whose AWARDED reality is Medium/Low that still got a >=HIGH threat verdict

high_awarded_correctly_high.note: P189 sampled High-priority misses -> these >=HIGH verdicts are NOT over-rating (confound to exclude)

decision_basis: Across the Medium/Low-awarded subset (the confound-free signal: quantamm M/L-hosting functions + P189 Medium-awarded + P198 Medium awarded), the blind verdict is >=HIGH in ~88.9% of cases. Centrifuge (controlled all-Medium/0-High) rated 11/12 surfaces >=HIGH. Only 1 MEDIUM_THREAD verdict in the entire 30-row dataset. The skew is systematic across 3 corpora-families. HONEST: the verdict is a THREAT CEILING by deep_trace.md design, not a calibrated severity -> the gap is a MISSING calibration gate, not a wrong verdict; P189's High-awarded >=HIGH verdicts (12/12) are correct, not over-rating, and are excluded from the rate.
caveats: n=30 verdict rows (directional; 6 corpora, clears >=3 bar but small)
awarded severity from id prefix (H/M/L); P198 awarded all Medium
verdict = worst-case threat ceiling (prompt design), NOT calibrated severity
P189 sample is High-biased -> measured over-HIGH only on Medium/Low-awarded subset to avoid inflation
